Article Title: Punjab Govt constitutes 7-member coordination committee over Sri Guru Granth Sahib (Amendment) Act, 2026
Article Text:
Punjab Govt constitutes 7-member coordination committee over Sri Guru Granth Sahib (Amendment) Act, 2026

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Chandigarh: The Punjab Government on Wednesday constituted a seven-member coordination committee regarding the Sri Guru Granth Sahib (Amendment) Act, 2026, in accordance with the directives of Sri Akal Takht Sahib.According to the Punjab Government, the newly formed panel includes former Jathedar of Sri Akal Takht Sahib GiRaghbir Singh, Head of Damdami Taksal Sant Giani Harnam Singh Khalsa, Sant Baba Sewa Singh Rampur Khera, retired Justice Jaspal Singh, retired Justice Gurbir Singh, retired IPS officer and PPSC Chairman Jatinder Singh Aulakh, and Law Officer Preet Inder Paul Singh.The state government stated that this committee will maintain continuous coordination with the committee constituted by Sri Akal Takht Sahib.Earlier, on April 20, the Punjab Government notified the Jaagat Jot Sri Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act, 2026, which aims to provide a framework governing the protection and sanctity of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and penalise acts of sacrilege.The notification followed Punjab Governor Gulab Chand Kataria granting his assent to the amendment bill on April 17. The amended legislation introduces stringent penalties for sacrilege, prescribing imprisonment ranging from 10 years to life along with fines between Rs 5 lakh and Rs 25 lakh for anyone involved in or supporting such acts.Punjab Finance Minister Harpal Singh Cheema declared that the enactment reflects the firm commitment of the Bhagwant Mann government to uphold the supreme honour and dignity of Guru Sahib. (ANI)"Government of Punjab has today notified the Sri Jaagat Jot Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act, 2026, passed in the recent Punjab Vidhan Sabha session and assented to by the Hon'ble Governor on 17th April. This reflects the firm commitment of the @BhagwantMann Government to uphold the supreme honour and dignity of Guru Sahib. Those involved in any act of sacrilege or dishonouring Guru Sahib will face the strictest consequences," said Cheema. (ANI)
Article Summary: Punjab govt constitutes 7-member coordination committee over sri guru granth sahib (amendment) act, 2026. The newly formed panel includes former jathedar of sri akal takht sahib giraghbir singh. The amended legislation introduces stringent penalties for sacrilege.

Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “I wanted to see what I could do to help her realize her potential”: How Naomi Osaka opened doors for a 9-year-old tennis player from Cameroon
Article Text:
How Naomi Osaka opened doors for a 9-year-old tennis player from Cameroon(Getty Images)

How Naomi Osaka learned about Uma’s tennis dream?

How Naomi Osaka gave the young tennis player a chance to grow?

How did Uma's scholarship reflect Naomi Osaka’s bigger mission?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Naomi Osaka has inspired countless young tennis players through her career, but one of her most personal philanthropic efforts began with a 9-year-old girl from Cameroon. Uma had watched Osaka play and dreamed of developing her own tennis career. When Osaka heard her story, she wanted to give her an opportunity that could help turn that dream into something real.Through Play Academy with Naomi Osaka, Uma received an individual scholarship to train at the Mouratoglou Tennis Academy in Nice, France. The opportunity gave her access to professional coaching, advanced facilities and other young talents. It also helped her develop habits away from the court, including discipline, focus and following a schedule.Play Academy with Naomi Osaka launched in 2020 to create more opportunities for girls through sport. The initiative works with sport-based organisations through grants and training while promoting positive experiences and gender-inclusive coaching.By 2023, Play Academy had expanded to Haiti and Los Angeles and had supported more than 10 grassroots programmes. Uma's scholarship was different because it was the initiative's first individual scholarship of its kind.The young tennis player was from Cameroon and had found inspiration in Osaka's career. Even from thousands of miles away, watching the Osaka play had encouraged Uma to pursue tennis herself.Osaka understood how important those opportunities could be for a young girl. “I know how impactful playing sport at an early age can be, especially for girls who don’t have equal opportunities as boys,” Osaka said.She pointed to several reasons girls can miss out on sport, including a lack of access, safe playing environments and financial limitations.Hearing Uma's story had a particular effect on Osaka because the young girl had been inspired by her despite living so far away.“I felt so humbled and moved when I heard Uma’s story and how watching me play inspired her, even all the way in Cameroon,” Osaka said.That was when Osaka decided to see how she could help Uma move forward.“So I wanted to see what I could do to help her realize her potential,” she said.The scholarship gave Uma the chance to train at the Mouratoglou Tennis Academy in Nice. Instead of only watching the player who inspired her, she could now develop her own game in a professional training environment.For Osaka, the goal was not to guarantee Uma a future in professional tennis. It was to give her access to an opportunity she might otherwise not have had.The Mouratoglou Tennis Academy offered Uma professional coaching and state-of-the-art facilities. She also trained around other junior players and gained experience in an environment built around developing young talent.Her coach, Dario Gioffre, quickly noticed that Uma had unusual ability for her age.“My first impression with Uma was ‘This is unreal.’ You don’t see a 9-year-old hitting that well and being so athletic on the court,” Gioffre said.Her ability surprised him, but he also understood the responsibility that came with coaching such a young player.“I was shocked, in a very positive way, and at the same time I felt a sense of immediate responsibility to work with such potential,” he said.Gioffre did not only focus on Uma's tennis ability. He also noticed her personality and willingness to learn. “The two qualities that come to mind when I think about Uma is happiness,” he said.He described her as someone who was always smiling and also highlighted her curiosity.“She always has questions and is eager to learn,” Gioffre added.The experience helped Uma improve her tennis, but the changes did not stop at her forehand.Uma later thanked Osaka for making the opportunity possible and explained what she had gained from her time at the academy.“I want to say thank you, Naomi Osaka, for making this experience possible at the Mouratoglou Tennis Academy,” Uma said.She said her forehand had improved significantly after one year of training. But she also spoke about lessons that could help her outside tennis.“I have learned a lot of discipline like following a schedule and sticking to it,” Uma said.She also learned how to stay focused when she felt afraid on the tennis court. Those lessons gave the scholarship a purpose beyond improving one young player's technique. Uma was learning how to handle the routine and pressure that come with being an athlete.Naomi Osaka also wanted that development to happen away from the court.“The Mouratoglou Tennis Academy has a wonderful reputation of working with various talents and helping them develop on and off the court,” Osaka said.She added that she was pleased the academy agreed to work with Play Academy to support Uma. The scholarship therefore gave Uma more than better facilities. She had professional guidance, a structured training environment and the chance to learn alongside other young players.Uma's story represented exactly the type of opportunity Naomi Osaka wanted Play Academy to create.The initiative was built around helping girls access sport and giving them positive experiences with coaches trained in gender inclusivity. Its work expanded across Japan, Haiti and Los Angeles, but the individual scholarship for Uma showed what that mission could look like when focused on one young athlete.Osaka knew that becoming a successful athlete requires more than talent. Young players need access to coaching, facilities and safe environments where they can develop.Uma had already found motivation by watching Osaka play. The scholarship helped turn that inspiration into an experience of her own.Naomi Osaka was clear about why she wanted to support her. “I wanted to see what I could do to help her realize her potential,” she said.The opportunity also gave Uma a chance to understand what professional training demands. Her comments about following a schedule and staying focused showed that the experience was changing how she approached tennis.Her coach also believed the sport could offer much more to young people than competition.“There’s a whole continent to explore. There’s a whole continent to develop,” Gioffre said.He believes tennis can help children and communities while giving young athletes opportunities to grow.“I strongly believe tennis is a sport for everyone and for life,” Gioffre added.In Osaka’s case, Uma's story was also connected to a larger problem. Girls can lose access to sport because of money, facilities, safety or simply not knowing what opportunities are available to them.Uma had already shown that she wanted to learn. Osaka's scholarship helped give her the environment to do it.For Naomi Osaka, the story began with something simple: a young girl in Cameroon watching her play and finding inspiration in what she saw.And for a 9-year-old who dreamed of becoming better at the sport she loved, that chance was already a significant beginning.
Article Summary: Play academy with naomi osaka launched in 2020 to create more opportunities for girls through sport. The initiative works with sport-based organisations through grants and training while promoting positive experiences and gender-inclusive coaching. Uma received an individual scholarship to train at the mouratoglou tennis academy in nice, france.

Article Title: LeBron James’ former Miami Heat teammate Dwyane Wade drops cryptic comment on ex-Laker ahead of NBA season opener
Article Text:
Dwyane Wade weighs in on LeBron James’ 76ers decision. Image via: Andrew D. Bernstein/NBAE via Getty Images |Chad Salvador/WWD via Getty

Dwyane Wade reacts to LeBron James signing with 76ers

Dwyane Wade on LeBron James skipping Miami Heat reunion

Dwyane Wade is not letting LeBron James ' offseason exit from the Lakers fade quietly into the background. The Miami Heat legend addressed his former teammate's decision to sign with the Philadelphia 76ers, and his response hinted that there is a layer to the move most people have not connected yet.James is set to debut for Philadelphia on October 20 against the defending champions, Knicks, and the buildup has already turned into a talking point across the league. Wade, never shy about weighing in on his old running mate, chose this moment to stir the pot without giving away exactly what he means.Dwyane Wade appeared on the "Conversations With Cam" podcast and was asked directly about James landing in Philadelphia. Rather than offering a simple take, the three-time NBA champion suggested there is more coming. "From a basketball standpoint, I thought it was a very strategic move at this point in his career," Wade said."I don't think we've seen the end of what this move is," Wade added, leaving the door open for speculation about what exactly he is referring to.Wade did not stop there. He called the decision a smart one for James at this stage of his career, pointing to the roster Philadelphia has built around him.The 76ers added Jaylen Brown in a trade that sent Paul George to Boston, then brought in Dean Wade and Anfernee Simons, giving James a starting lineup that also includes Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe and Joel Embiid. Wade framed the fit as one that gives James a real path back to championship contention in the East.The question Heat fans really wanted answered was why James never seriously circled back to Miami. Wade did not dodge it. "I think Miami would have been a good move as wel. but there's a lot of moving parts in that that needed to go right," Wade said.He acknowledged a reunion would have made sense on paper, especially with Miami retooling around Giannis Antetokounmpo and adding sharpshooter Klay Thompson, but he pointed out that too many pieces would have needed to line up for it to actually happen.The answer will not satisfy everyone in South Florida. Plenty of Heat fans still believe pairing James with Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo would have given him the best combination of talent and market appeal anywhere in his free agency search. Wade's comments suggest even he sees the logic in that argument, even if he ultimately backed James' choice to head to Philadelphia instead.
Article Summary: Dwyane wade appeared on the "conversations with cam" podcast. He was asked about lebron james' decision to sign with the philadelphia 76ers. Wade said he thought it was a "very strategic move at this point in his career" james is set to debut for philadelphia on october 20 against the knicks.

Article Title: Jaxson Dart's girlfriend Marissa Ayers is already the Giants' most fashionable fan and the season just started

Who is Marissa Ayers, and how did she get here so fast?

Jaxson Dart got his first primetime NFL win on Sunday Night Football, shutting out the Dallas Cowboys 28-20 at MetLife Stadium. But two days later, it was not the quarterback dominating everyone's feed. It was his girlfriend, Marissa Ayers. She posted a game-day gallery on Instagram that pulled in thousands of reactions -- a baby blue maxi dress, a high slit, and a caption that summed up the night better than most highlight reels. The season is barely a week old, and Ayers is already the most talked-about face in the Giants' stands.Ayers posted the gallery Tuesday, two days after the Cowboys game, and the look immediately took over the comment section. The baby blue maxi dress matched the Giants' colors and came with a sharp high slit up the front. She paired it with sunglasses, and the whole thing felt deliberate without being try-hard. Her caption read, "My boy's bringing six-y back," a nod to Dart's number and the win that went with it.The rest of the gallery had its own quiet charm. A shot of her heels in the stands. A selfie in the crowd. A video of her kissing Dart on the field after the game.The American flag stretched across MetLife in the background. She did not need to say much. The pictures did most of the talking.Fans responded fast. "I'm not sure what I like more -- the outfit, the caption, or the win," one follower wrote. Another asked Ayers to make sure Dart stays healthy all season. A third kept it simple: "Perfect in every way." For someone who has only been publicly linked to Dart since late 2025, the response she gets now belongs to someone who has been in this world much longer.Ayers is 23, a University of Alabama graduate and a model who has worked as a ring girl for Jake Paul's Most Valuable Promotions. She was in the ring for the Paul-Anthony Joshua fight, which gave her a certain kind of visibility before the NFL ever entered the picture. She and Dart were first spotted together at a Halloween party in October 2025. By January 2026, they were Instagram official. By February, they were on the red carpet together at the NFL Honors.The relationship moved quickly and so did her profile. Dart flew out to Miami in May to watch her walk the runway at Miami Swim Week, front row, no entourage necessary. She returned the support by visiting him during Giants training camp in New Jersey shortly after the team came back from West Virginia. That visit made the rounds too, with photos of the two laughing and catching up after practice circulating across NFL fan accounts.None of this happened by accident. Ayers is active, present, and comfortable in front of a camera -- qualities that build a following in real time during an NFL season. With Dart now under national spotlight every Sunday night, her visibility is only going to grow. One win in, and she is already the face of Giants gameday fashion. By January, that could mean something much bigger.
Article Summary: Marissa ayers wore a baby blue maxi dress to the giants' season opener. She posted a game-day gallery on instagram that pulled in thousands of reactions. She and quarterback jaxson dart were first spotted together in october 2025.

Article Title: Aaron Rodgers’ Shailene Woodley comments take an unexpected turn as podcasters struggle to make sense of his confession
Article Text:
Aaron Rodgers opens up about Shailene Woodley (Getty Images)

What exactly did Aaron Rodgers say about Shailene Woodley on the podcast?

Why are podcasters and fans still talking about the Rodgers-Woodley confession days later?

Aaron Rodgers has never been someone who shies away from controversy. But what he said on Cam Heyward's "Not Just Football" podcast last week genuinely threw people off. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback revisited his broken engagement with actress Shailene Woodley , and the details he shared stopped sports fans and entertainment followers dead in their tracks. Within hours, social media was flooded. Podcasters were scrambling. And the version of events that the public had accepted for years suddenly looked very different.Aaron Rodgers laid it out plainly. He said he proposed to Woodley in December 2020, she said yes, and then just days later, she told him something he clearly never forgot. "I proposed, and she says yes… But a couple of days after that, she tells me, 'You know, before we get married, I gotta go fu--ing this guy,'" Rodgers said on the show.He did not name the person. That detail alone sent the internet into a spiral.Beyond that admission, Rodgers pushed back on how the split has been framed publicly for years. The narrative, as most people understood it, was that Rodgers left Woodley emotionally destroyed. He rejected that entirely. He said Woodley had removed her engagement ring by March 2021, barely four months after he proposed, and later told him directly, "I don't want to be with you."In Rodgers' version of events, there was no dramatic exit on his part. The relationship had already quietly ended before the public knew anything was wrong.Woodley, for her part, did not get into specifics when approached about his comments at a pre-Emmys event in Los Angeles. She reportedly laughed and walked away. No statement, no rebuttal.Because the mystery of the unnamed man is impossible to ignore.Maria Ciuffo and Francesca Mariano of the Chicks in the Office podcast captured what most people were feeling. Ciuffo said it plainly: "I can't wrap my head around this and immediately your brain starts going, who? Who was she talking about?" Mariano pushed the question further, wondering aloud whether this was someone Woodley had history with or someone she had simply been thinking about."Here's the question, do we think it's somebody she's already slept with, and it's like this guy was fu-king amazing, or it's someone that's just been on her wish list?" Mariano said. "It is hilarious, though, if she just had one fucking guy in mind."Ciuffo took it one step further, joking that the only thing that could top Rodgers' confession would be Woodley identifying the person herself. "Imagine Shailene Woodley just got online and was like, 'listen, I wanted to fuck Miles Teller,'" Ciuffo joked.That response, funny as it was, pointed to something real. Rodgers handed the public a story with no ending. He gave the what but not the who. And in 2026, that kind of open-ended revelation does not stay quiet. It gets picked apart, debated, and turned into content for days.What makes this moment genuinely interesting is not just the confession itself. It is that Rodgers chose to say this now, four years after the breakup, right as a new NFL season begins. Whether that was calculated or just unfiltered honesty is a question only he can answer.
Article Summary: Aaron rodgers said he proposed to shailene woodley in december 2020. Days later, she told him, "you know, before we get married, i gotta go fu--ing this guy" he did not name the person, but that detail alone sent the internet into a spiral.

Article Title: Tyreek Hill purchased a $6.9 million Florida mansion after landing in Miami; four years later his NFL future changed and the $7.7 million listing quietly disappeared
Article Text:
Tyreek Hill (Imagn Images)

What happened to Tyreek Hill's $7.7 million Florida home?

What did Tyreek Hill's Southwest Ranches mansion actually look like?

Why did the Miami Dolphins cut Tyreek Hill?

Could Tyreek Hill still play in the NFL in 2026?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

What does this all mean for Tyreek Hill's legacy in Miami?

Tyreek Hill purchased his Southwest Ranches mansion for $6.9 million in 2022, days after signing a four-year, $120 million contract extension with the Miami Dolphins. Four years later, everything around him unraveled. Hill dislocated his left knee and tore multiple ligaments, including his ACL, during a Monday Night Football win over the New York Jets in Week 4 of the 2025 season. The Dolphins released him in February 2026, saving $22.8 million in cap space. He listed the home for $7.7 million on March 19. Then, months later, the listing quietly came down.Hill took the sprawling Florida mansion off the market just months after listing it for $7.7 million, with records showing the property was removed as his former Dolphins teammates began preparing for the new season.The timing says a lot. He put the house up for sale in the same breath as becoming a free agent, which read as a clean break from Miami on every front. Now the listing is gone, and Hill himself remains unsigned heading into the 2026 NFL season. There is no new team yet. There is no new home. What there is, apparently, is a knee he is not ready to test on an NFL field and a property he has decided not to rush selling.His agent, Drew Rosenhaus, told The Pat McAfee Show that Hill's doctors have recommended postponing his comeback until around October, adding: "We're playing it on the safe side.We're not in a rush. We just want him to be completely healthy. There's a ton of interest, as you can imagine. We just want to make sure that he's 100% good to go."If the house is coming off the market while the team situation is still wide open, Hill is not closing any doors. He is waiting for the right one.The nine-bedroom, 9.5-bath home sits in Southwest Ranches, Florida, and the main level includes a home gym, wood-paneled office, and an open kitchen adjacent to a family room, with a primary suite that opens directly to the pool and grounds.The property sits in a gated community 15 miles southwest of Fort Lauderdale and about 22 miles northwest of Miami, in a 9,300-square-foot European-inspired build that includes a game room, recording studio, movie room, and a massive pool. Hill added his own personal touches over his years there. Those include a podcast recording room, arcade games, and a pool room. He even planned to install a shark tank in the formal living room, per a YouTube tour he filmed of the place. That detail alone tells you something about how he approached life in Miami. This was not just a house. It was a statement.The outdoor space matches the interior ambition: an infinity heated pool, a 10-person spa, an outdoor kitchen, a fire pit, an NBA-sized basketball court, a four-car garage, two guest houses, a mini golf course, and multiple fountains.He bought it as the highest-paid wide receiver in NFL history at the time. He customized it to reflect who he was off the field, not just on it.The short answer is money. Hill's final contract year carried a cap hit of nearly $52 million, with $11 million in guaranteed salary and a $5 million roster bonus that would have kicked in on the third day of the 2026 league year, releasing him saved the Dolphins those obligations.But the injury made the math easier. Hill's dislocated knee carried multiple torn ligaments, ending his 2025 season four games in, and the road ahead was described as long even for a player of his caliber and recovery history. An outright release before the start of the 2026 league year was already on the table regardless of injury because of how his contract was structured.There is also the larger football picture. His 2024 season, by his own standards, was his worst with Miami. The year prior he caught 81 passes for 959 yards and six touchdowns, respectable numbers for most receivers but a meaningful step down from the 119 catches, 1,799 yards, and 13 touchdowns he put up in 2023, which remain one of the greatest single-season receiving performances in league history. The Dolphins were paying elite-receiver money for a player whose production was trending the wrong way, and then the knee ended even that conversation.Hill's release on February 16, 2026 made him an unrestricted free agent for the first time in his career, at age 32.Rosenhaus has consistently maintained that his client is coming back. Hill has been posting Instagram videos showing his recovery progress throughout the winter and spring, offering glimpses of his work behind the scenes, though not the kind of on-field movement that would ease doubts about his readiness.As the 2026 NFL season began, Hill remained a free agent, out of sight and out of mind for most of the league. He watched Week 1 from the sidelines and shared his reactions on social media, writing that fans' support had him in tears. That is not the response of a player who has mentally checked out. That is someone still deeply invested in coming back, watching the game without him and feeling every bit of the distance.Rosenhaus confirmed there is interest from teams, and the current plan targets an October return date. If that holds, Hill could join a contender mid-season as a proven playmaker, assuming he can show teams he is close to what he was. That is a big assumption at 32, coming off a knee dislocation and ACL tear. But Hill has spent his entire career outrunning assumptions.Four years. One historic season. A career-threatening injury. A $120 million contract. A house that went on the market and then came back off.Miami gave Hill more money than any receiver had ever made, and he gave Miami the best single season any receiver has ever had. Then it fell apart fast. The 2024 season brought declining numbers and friction with the front office. The 2025 season lasted four weeks. His release saved the Dolphins $22.8 million in cap space and left one of the most electric playmakers of his generation without a team.The mansion situation almost perfectly mirrors the career arc. He bought it as a statement. He listed it when everything collapsed. He took it back off the market when the future stopped being clear. That is where he is right now: somewhere between done and not done, between one chapter and whatever comes next. The house stays. The NFL career? Still being written.
Article Summary: Tyreek hill listed his florida mansion for $7.7 million on march 19. The miami dolphins cut him in february 2026, saving $22.8 million in cap space. Hill's agent says doctors have recommended postponing his comeback until october. The nine-bedroom, 9.5-bath home sits in southwest ranches, florida.

Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra , who led India’s 1-2 finish in the men’s event at the last Asian Games in Hangzhou, is out with an injury. Two-time defending champion in men’s shot put Tajinderpal Singh is not in his best form and women’s javelin throw gold medallist Annu Rani failed to make the cut. Will it then be a tough outing for India’s athletes?The answer could surprise many because the Athletics Federation of India (AFI) has nurtured a new breed of talented athletes capable of repeating or even improving the performance from the last edition of the Games held in China.The focus will be on Gulveer Singh, who has now risen in stature as is earning recognition among the finest long distance runners India has produced. The Services runner, who trains in the US, settled for the bronze medal in the last Games but this time he will start as a gold medal contender. Gulveer’s time of 27 minutes, 24.28s clocked in March, is the 12th fastest in the world this season.In the women’s section, athletics fans will be gunning for an Indian double in the long jump and the 400m hurdles. Ancy Sojan will be the flag bearer in the long jump. Her big leap of 6.88m at the National Inter-State athletics meet erased Anju Bobby George’s long-standing mark of 6.83m set in 1994.Shaili Singh is expected to give Ancy a strong challenge. So far, it has been Ancy all the way but Shaili is capable of producing an upset win.The oldest record in Indian athletics, PT Usha’s 55.42s in the women’s 400m hurdles, will again come under threat with last edition’s bronze winner Vithya Ramraj and Anu Raghavan, whose standing at the 2010 Games was upgraded from 4th to third, ready for a grand stand finish. Both clocked their season’s best in Bhubaneswar in June; Vithya won the race in 56.07s and Anu finished second in 56.54s.The trio of Murali Sreeshankar (8.38m, Asian leader, men’s long jump), Sarvesh Anil Kushare (2.31m Asian lead, men’s high jump) and Tejaswin Shankar (8057 points, Asia second, decathlon) will all eye the top step on the podium.With impressive performances this season, the trio will look to add a title here to their collection. The return of Avinash Sable (defending champion in men’s 3000m steeplechase), after missing the Commonwealth Games, will be watched keenly.The other medal contenders include Sawan Barwal (men’s marathon), Praveen Chitravel (men’s triple jump), Rohit Yadav (men’s javelin throw), Toor (men’s shot put), Parul Chaudhary (women’s 5000m) and Jyothi Yarraji (women’s 100m hurdles), men’s 4x400m relay, women’s 4x400m relay and mixed 4x400m relay teams.

Article Title: Harmanpreet Kaur will rediscover batting form at Asian Games: Anjum Chopra
Article Text:
Harmanpreet Kaur (ANI Photo)

MUMBAI: Amid growing calls for a leadership change in Indian women’s cricket, former India captain Anjum Chopra has backed Harmanpreet Kaur to continue leading the side, insisting she remains the best person for the job despite recent scrutiny over her form.Harmanpreet scored 71 runs in five matches at the Women’s T20 Asia Cup in Dubai, where India lifted a record-extending eighth title. With the skipper now 37 and vice-captain Smriti Mandhana 30, suggestions of a transition in leadership have gathered momentum.Chopra, however, believes Harmanpreet remains India’s best captain. “People keep talking about changing the captain, but somebody has to lead every Indian team. As of now, Harmanpreet is the best captain to lead India,” Chopra told TOI.While acknowledging that Harmanpreet’s batting in Dubai fell below expectations, Chopra warned against judging the veteran solely on recent returns. “We always expect a special innings from her, something that reminds us of the 171 not out she scored against Australia in the 2017 World Cup. But that won’t happen every time,” she said.Chopra is confident the experienced batter will rediscover her rhythm as India build towards the inaugural Women’s Champions Trophy in 2027.“She knows fluency with the bat will be important going into major tournaments. The upcoming assignments, including the Asian Games and future bilateral series, will help her get there. She may be on the other side of 30, but India still need her services as captain and batter,” Chopra said.Fresh from an unbeaten Asia Cup campaign, India enter the Asian Games in Japan as defending champions and overwhelming favourites. Chopra believes adapting quickly to unfamiliar conditions will be their biggest challenge.“Understanding the pitches, environment and playing conditions will be crucial. On paper, India have a stronger side than the other Asian teams, but no tournament can be taken lightly. If they adapt well and play to their strengths, they should start as favourites,” she said.Chopra also praised Shafali Verma, who topped the scoring charts at the Asia Cup with 236 runs at a strike rate of 171.01 and three half-centuries.(Watch the Asian Games 2026 live and exclusive on Sony Sports Network and Sony LIV.)

Chopra is confident the experienced batter will rediscover her rhythm as india build towards the inaugural women's champions trophy in 2027. India enter the asian games in japan as defending champions and overwhelming favourites.

Article Title: 'Unexpected opportunity': Vipraj Nigam earns Asian Games call-up, to replace injured Varun Chakravarthy
Article Text:
Vipraj Nigam

LUCKNOW: It was double delight for Uttar Pradesh’s young leg-spinner and allrounder Vipraj Nigam after he earned both a place in the India ‘A’ squad for the home one-day series against Australia ‘A’ and a place in India’s Asian Games squad. Nigam has been included after senior spinner Varun Chakravarthy was ruled out of the continental event with a side strain.Nigam learnt about his selection while attending a two-day spinners’ camp at the Centre of Excellence (CoE). “I’m currently at a two-day camp at the NCA and only today I found out that I’ve received a call-up for the Asian Games. It feels great. I had a feeling that my name might come up for a series at some point, but I never expected the opportunity to come this quickly,” Nigam told TOI.The 21-year-old credited his family, coach Sarwar Nawab and his recent exposure to India ‘A’ and the senior team setup for his progress. “This is what we work hard and play matches for, to reach this level. I’d like to thank my family and coach Sarwar Nawab, who have put in so much effort for me. Now it’s my turn to repay them,” he said.Nigam toured Sri Lanka with India ‘A’ last year and also bowled in the nets for the senior Indian team.He said those experiences had helped him develop as a cricketer. “I want to bring those lessons into my game and adapt them well. I recently applied them in the UPT20 League and I plan to continue using them in the matches ahead,” he said.During the Sri Lanka tour, Nigam said he benefitted from working with spin coach Sairaj Bahutule, a former leg-spinner. “Since he is also a leg-spinner, he helped clear many of my doubts.I also learnt a great deal from Gautam Gambhir and senior players such as KL Rahul, Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeep Yadav, including during the IPL,” he said.The UP cricketer, who has represented the state in all three formats over the past two years, said switching between red-ball and white-ball cricket has become easier with experience. “I understand now when to shift between the formats. I don’t face too much difficulty,” he said. Nigam also credited Axar Patel and KL Rahul with helping him improve his batting.

Article Title: After Asia Cup trophy snub, Kapil Dev dodges Mohsin Naqvi bullet with a witty one-liner
Article Text:
Kapil Dev dodges Mohsin Naqvi

BCCI explains the decision

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: India’s women’s cricket team won the Asia Cup for a record eighth time on Sunday. But the post-match celebrations were overshadowed by the team’s decision not to receive the trophy from Asian Cricket Council chief Mohsin Naqvi, who is also Pakistan’s interior minister and the chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB).The decision echoed a similar incident involving India’s men’s team at the 2025 Asia Cup, where Suryakumar Yadav-led side also refused to take the trophy from Naqvi. The development drew widespread discussion once again.Former India captain Kapil Dev , when asked about the team's decision not to receive the trophy from the PCB chief, came up with a brief and witty response. "Tell all of them to play golf," he told news agency ANI.Watch:India had beaten Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the final in Dubai to lift their eighth Women's Asia Cup title.However, the Indian players did not attend the official trophy presentation involving Naqvi. The episode came a year after the men's team had also declined to receive the Asia Cup trophy from him.BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia said the board had already informed the organisers about its position before the presentation ceremony.According to him, the decision was not a last-minute reaction to events at the venue.“Winning the trophy is one thing, but winning the tournament is what truly matters. The issue regarding the trophy, which created a controversy, did not stem from our side. We had already clarified our stance, referencing the situation we faced last year regarding the Asian Games–a matter known to the entire nation,” Saikia told ANI.He added that the board had also made it clear that the team would not participate if the trophy presentation went ahead in the planned format.“We maintained our position based on that context. We had stated beforehand that we did not approve the manner in which they had planned the prize distribution ceremony. We informed their chairman that if they proceeded with that specific system, we would not participate. Since they did not agree, we chose not to accept the trophy in that manner; we will collect it later,” he added.Saikia also clarified that the decision was not made independently by the players and that there was no disagreement between the team and the BCCI.“This was entirely the BCCI’s decision. We had discussed everything internally, and the BCCI’s stance remains consistent with what it was previously. Whether it concerns the players, the team, or the BCCI officials, we are all united; there is no divergence between the players’ decisions and the BCCI’s decisions. We act as one. Whatever decision is taken, we proceed in accordance with the BCCI’s established policies,” he said.
Article Summary: Kapil dev dodges mohsin naqvi question by saying 'tell all of them to play golf' india had beaten sri lanka by 72 runs in the final in dubai to lift their eighth women's asia cup title. The indian players did not attend the official trophy presentation involvingnaqvi.

Article Title: Asian Games 2026: Indian athletes land in Japan to a forgettable welcome
Article Text:
Samaresh gets wrong accreditation

Citing shortage of govt funds, riders left to foot horse feed bill

Japan’s reputation for organisational efficiency lay in tatters as the rowing and shooting contingent faced unexpected ordeals upon arrival. A majority of the rowing squad were left stranded without accommodation, some of their names actually missing from the accreditation system.“Only three of the 22 men’s athletes have accommodation against their names. And the names of three of the five women rowers (Poonam, Aleena Anto and Anshika Bharati) are not registered with the hosts even though they all have valid accreditation,” said a Rowing Federation of India (RFI) official.The rowers’ nightmare had actually begun even before they boarded their flight. One of the groups that left Mumbai on Tuesday night was told by Cathay Pacific that they would not be allowed to check in their oars. Later, the oars were flown to Delhi. They will arrive in Nagoya on Thursday morning, just in time for the first official practice session.Adding to the agony was the Sports Authority of India’s belated intimation that women’s coach Ratheesh Kumar and team manager Ramakrishnan Ramachandran would have to manage their accommodation on their own.Meanwhile, the shooters had to wait for almost three hours for their transport after reaching the Nagoya airport at 9 pm on Tuesday.“We didn’t get the bus and there was no food. Everything was closed at the airport. The welcome centre had no information, so we had to wait and reach the hotel around 4 am,” a team member told TOI.India’s pistol shooting head coach Samaresh Jung was in for a rude shock when he came to know his accreditation didn’t allow him to enter the players arena and the field of play during the matches. “It was a shock when we saw Samaresh’s accreditation. When we enquired, we were told that this was done according to the list the organisers had received from the Indian Olympic Association,” a source said.“We contacted our office at the National Rifle Association of India, and the issue was taken up. We are told that Samaresh will be getting the new accreditation tomorrow,” the source said. Samaresh’s absence would dent India’s medal chances as most of the 10m air pistol shooters like Suruchi Phogat, Akash Bhardwaj have been training under him.Indian equestrian riders who are preparing for the Asian Games have been left scrambling to arrange hay, bedding and fodder for their horse combinations, with the Indian Olympic Association (IOA)-appointed ad-hoc committee running the sport citing a “shortage of govt funds”, reports Sabi Hussain.A mail accessed by TOI, signed by Lt Col Sandeep Dewan, member (administration), ad-hoc panel and team leader of the equestrian contingent, states that funds released to the national federation have been largely insufficient even to clear the bill of transporter Peden Bloodstock. The federation, the mail adds, has covered the shortfall from its own funds.“We regret to inform you that the govt has so far not released any funds for payment of feed and other expenses related to the maintenance of the horses whilst in Japan,” Dewan wrote.The riders have been asked to purchase feed and other stable requirements directly and claim reimbursement later.The financial strain extends beyond Japan. Riders said they had personally borne expenses for food, travel, accommodation and fees during the horses’ mandatory quarantine in Germany.Reimbursements for pre-quarantine tests, blood and swab tests, horse transportation, athlete accommodation and groom accommodation also remain pending. “Timely support on these essential matters is extremely important for us to focus completely on our performance in the Asian Games,” a rider told TOI on Wednesday.
Article Summary: India's rowing and shooting contingent faced unexpected ordeals upon arrival. Majority of the rowing squad were left stranded without accommodation. Some of their names were actually missing from the accreditation system. Samaresh jung was in for a rude shock when he came to know his accreditation didn’t allow him to enter the players arena and the field of play during the matches.

Article Title: ‘Not a robot, but used to tough calls’: Samson on Sooryavanshi competition, relentless scrutiny and the fight for his place in XI
Article Text:
Sanju Samson, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The ‘inconsistent’ tag has long followed Sanju Samson . He made his T20I debut as a 20-year-old in 2015 but his place in the Indian team is never assured. On Tuesday night, after scoring his first half-century since the dream run in the T20 World Cup in March, Samson highlighted the difficulty of achieving consistency with a high-risk approach necessary in T20Is.“You can’t control the consistency in the result in this format. Consistency has to be in the frame of mind. I think that’s what ‘fearless mindset’ is called,” Samson said after scoring a 57 off 22 that helped India seal the series against Afghanistan here. The last T20I of the series will be played on Thursday.With India’s T20I team boasting of three other equally destructive openers — Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi — Samson’s place in the team is always under scrutiny. Two months ago, he was benched in England when Sooryavanshi played ahead of him. Samson, who will be 32 years old in another two months, said the experience of taking hard calls as an IPL captain helped him understand the team management’s position on Sooryavanshi.“It’s not easy to run an Indian team. A 15-year-old boy has scored 700-800 runs in the IPL . My World Cup was before that. He had to come in some or the other manner,” he said.“I didn’t perform in 2-3 games and he was in form and we wanted to win games in that series. I have been in this situation and I have taken tough calls as a captain in the IPL.”Samson, however, did concede that he gets affected at times. “At first, it feels bad. I am not a machine. I am not a robot. It definitely matters. And you kind of get a bit affected. But then you try to talk to yourself and tell that what you are and what you need to do,” he said.“I try to turn off the Wi-Fi. But sometimes the Wi-Fi turns on and I see the comments of the senior players,” Samson said of the endless debate over his spot in the XI. “It’s their choice. They can use a positive frame of sentences or they can use a negative frame of sentences. I think I am experienced enough to handle it.”
Article Summary: Sanju samson scored 57 off 22 to help india seal the series against afghanistan. The last t20i of the series will be played on thursday. Samson was benched in england when vaibhav sooryavanshi played ahead of him. He said experience of taking hard calls as an ipl captain helped him understand team management's position.

The national selectors, who announced the team on Wednesday, also pulled Nitish Kumar Reddy out of the Asian Games squad and picked him to play the ODI series.TOI has learnt that the selectors and team management weren’t convinced that Hardik Pandya would be ready to play the series starting on Sept 27.Sources said that the selectors want to focus on grooming a seam-bowling allrounder backup for Pandya keeping in mind next year’s ODI World Cup in South Africa.“The Centre of Excellence has reported that Pandya is fit enough to bowl six overs at full intensity. Article Title: Pakistan cricket crisis deepens as Mohammad Rizwan moves Lahore High Court against cyber crime agency summons
Article Text:
Mohammad Rizwan (Getty Images)

What did the NCCIA ask?

Major changes in Pakistan team

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Pakistan wicketkeeper-batter Mohammad Rizwan has approached the Lahore High Court against summons issued to him by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA). Rizwan appeared before the agency last week but has now questioned the basis of the investigation and its authority to summon him.Rizwan filed a writ petition on Monday, raising concerns over what is understood to be the lack of any specific allegation against him. He has also questioned the NCCIA’s jurisdiction in the matter.The development comes after Rizwan and fellow batter Imam-ul-Haq were called for questioning following Pakistan’s 3-0 Test series loss in England. Both players appeared at the NCCIA’s Lahore office last Thursday and were later given detailed questionnaires to complete.The questionnaires are believed to have sought information about the players’ travel and financial history, along with details about their personal and professional lives. While Imam is understood to have submitted his answers through an intermediary before the September 15 deadline, Rizwan has challenged aspects of the investigation.It is not clear whether the NCCIA inquiry is linked to a separate internal investigation being conducted by the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB).The PCB had announced that it had "initiated an internal disciplinary inquiry following media reports concerning discipline and conduct, which are currently being reviewed internally". The board said the process was being "conducted under PCB regulations".Rizwan and Imam were among seven players sent home after Pakistan suffered a 194-run defeat against England in the second Test at Lord’s. Pakistan had already lost the first Test by an innings and 103 runs.The PCB made several changes after the defeats, with seven replacements sent to England, including five uncapped players. Head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed and bowling coach Umar Gul were also removed.Pakistan went on to lose the third Test at Edgbaston by eight wickets. Razaullah, one of the replacements, impressed on debut with four wickets and an 81-run innings.Rizwan scored 12, 41, 7 and 1 in the two Tests he played in England. He had also struggled with the bat during Pakistan’s two-Test series in the West Indies.Imam, meanwhile, suffered a grade-one tear in his left calf after the opening day at Lord’s and took no further part in the match. His injury was questioned publicly by chief selector and high-performance director Aaqib Javed.PCB chairman Mohsin Naqvi had said the review would look beyond performances."We have had a discussion to ascertain the reasons behind it. They include factors beyond performance and we will get to the bottom of it," said Naqvi, as quoted by Cricinfo.The selection of Rizwan and Imam had also come under scrutiny, with the PCB seeking an explanation from a selection committee member over their selection. Selector Misbah-ul-Haq later resigned following the squad changes.
Article Summary: Pakistan wicketkeeper-batter mohammad rizwan has approached the lahore high court against summons issued to him by the national cyber crime investigation agency. The development comes after rizwana and fellow batter imam-ul-haq were called for questioning following pakistan’s 3-0 test series loss in england.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge
Article Text:
El Rubius reacted honestly after his elimination from MrBeast’s $1 million challenge, calling it “unfair” and claiming he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings. His response felt real and balanced, especially after MrBeast’s team later sent him a cake, softening the moment.

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

El Rubius did not just walk away from MrBeast’s $1 million streamer challenge. He opened up. Soon after his elimination, the Spanish creator shared a raw reaction with fans, giving them a closer look at what the experience felt like from inside the game. It was not polished or carefully framed. It felt real, and that is exactly why it caught attention so quickly.The clip and his response have since fueled conversations across the streaming space. Some viewers believe intense competitions like this naturally lead to uneven situations. Others feel Rubius may have had a point about being singled out. Either way, his words have added a human layer to a challenge that many only saw as entertainment.Speaking through an Instagram Story, Rubius did not hide his frustration, but he also made sure to thank his supporters. He said, "Guys, I just got knocked out of the game. It was a bit of an unfair elimination, but hey, at least I managed to walk away with $50,000 for you all, which I’ve already distributed. It went to the mods, the subs, and the non-subs alike."He further added, "I’m happy, of course, though admittedly, it was incredibly tough.I wasn't really a fan of the challenge itself, either. But then again... it was basically a three-against-one situation the entire time. I mean, they were targeting me specifically the whole way through. I kept trying to go after RaKai, but, well, he actually just got eliminated in the end. So, at least justice was served for Abraham. Abraham, if you’re watching this, we were all rooting for you, and standing right there with you."His message carried mixed emotions. There was disappointment, yes, but also pride in how he handled things. Giving away his $50,000 winnings to his community stood out as a gesture that meant more than the result itself.He continued with another honest note, saying, "And in the end, karma finally caught up with that little punk. Sorry, I’m being a bit toxic right now, but let's just hope the MrBeast team doesn't see this! Guys, thank you all so much. Seriously, thank you for all the support and for just being there."He added, "Every time I asked for something in the chat or whatever it was, you guys were right there. You’re incredible. I’m a little disappointed in myself, personally, mostly for not performing better, but hey, I gave it my all, and we still walked away with $50,000, so we’ve got to look on the bright side. All right, guys, big hugs to all my brothers out there!"Interestingly, the story did not end with frustration. Later that day, Rubius revealed that MrBeast’s team had sent him a cake after his exit. It was a small gesture, but it shifted the mood. It showed that even in a high-pressure challenge, there is still room for respect.In the end, Rubius’ reaction felt honest and grounded. That is what stayed with people.
Article Summary: El rubius was eliminated from mrbeast's $1 million challenge. He called it "unfair" and said he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings.

NEW DELHI: IPL comes and the demand for tickets and passes go soaring up by the fans. The desperation to get inside the stadium to watch their favourite teams in action in the IPL go high and high. When the tickets get sold out, the demand gets too hig, and the cricket fans even ask for tickets in black. But for a 25-year-old techie the craze for IPL tickets for RCB vs CSK turned too costly and he was duped for a massive Rs. 1.46 lakh.The techie, a resident of B Narayanapura, fell into a trap by a post posted by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram.As per a report in Deccan Herald, the techie alleged in a complaint to Mahadevapura Police that an individual claiming to be Sumit Biswal promised he could arrange IPL tickets along with food coupons.As per the techie, Biswal was introduced him as a senior supervisor for ticket counter at M Chinnaswamy Stadium"He asked me to come near the stadium gate number 10, saying someone would deliver the tickets within minutes, and even sent an email confirmation to gain my trust," the complainant told Deccan Herald."Initially, I agreed to buy two tickets for Rs 3,700 each,but he kept asking for more money under various pretexts such as refundable security deposits, additional ID cards and food coupons.Trusting him, I made multiple payments - even using my mother’s bank account after exhausting my own limits—and ended up transferring around Rs 1.46 lakh," he added.Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s incisive spell of 3-41, coming after a marauding batting show from Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal, propelled Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to a commanding 43-run victory over Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in their IPL 2026 encounter at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday.The contest saw RCB’s batting unit dismantle CSK’s attack with relentless hitting, as David’s 70 not out off just 25 balls and Patidar’s unbeaten 48 off only 19 balls provided for the late fireworks after Padikkal’s fluent 50 off 29 balls had set the tone for the daunting total.Their combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026. In reply, CSK faltered under scoreboard pressure, with Sarfaraz Khan’s 50 off 24 balls and Prashant Veer’s 43 the lone acts of resistance amid a string of failures from the top order.Bhuvneshwar was at his disciplined best and even crossed the 200-mark in terms of wickets in IPL, with others also chipping in as CSK were bowled out for 207 in 19.4 overs. Article Title: A sealed early copy of Super Mario Bros. remained inside a Nintendo console bundle for decades; when discovered in 2026, it sold for $3 million
Article Text:
A representative image of old game consoles. Image credits: Wikimedia Commons

The cartridge belonged to an early production run

A representative image of old Mario game console. Image credits: Wikimedia Commons

The game remained inside its original Nintendo bundle

For nearly four decades, a copy of Super Mario Bros. was sealed inside an unopened Nintendo Entertainment System bundle. The copy was then discovered in 2026. The cartridge, preserved in its original packaging and accompanied by the Control Deck console with which it was originally bundled, eventually went to Heritage Auctions . It was sold for $3 million on 12 June 2026, setting a record for the highest price paid for a video game at a public auction.The cartridge received a PSA 9.6 A++ grade and was identified as a sealed example of Super Mario Bros.’ second production run. One of the things that made the find especially unusual was that it carried a short-lived gloss sticker seal associated with an early production variant. Meanwhile, the original console bundle itself had remained unopened. Contemporary reports suggest that only three sealed copies of this particular second-production variant were known, and the newly discovered one was considered the highest-graded of them.The NES and Super Mario Bros. dated to Nintendo’s early expansion of its home console business in the United States. It is, however, important to note that the console and cartridge should not be treated as though they came from the exact same production moment. Heritage Auctions’ description identifies the bundle as a 1985-styled USA Nintendo NES Control Deck release distributed in 1986.Meanwhile, the Super Mario Bros. cartridge itself is described as a second-production gloss-sticker example. Nintendo reportedly adopted the gloss sticker in early 1986, after the short-lived matte sticker used on launch copies from its October 1985 test market.The game itself is not a first-production copy. Instead, it is a second-production example which has been described as the earliest confirmed sealed copy because no sealed first-production example is currently known. Aside from the newly discovered one, the other two have received VGA 80 and Wata 9.4 A++ grades. The production history, therefore, provides an explanation for why a very common game could turn into an exceptionally rare collectable in one particular form.The preservation of the cartridge was equally unconventional, as the original inner packaging remained intact. The console and its components had never even been removed from their plastic. The auction lot contained the Control Deck with which the Super Mario Bros. cartridge had originally been packaged. This indicates that the game had not been passed down between collectors; instead, it remained inside the original packaging, secured.Following its discovery two months prior to the sale, Heritage placed the cartridge and Control Deck together in its 12-13 June 2026 Video Games Signature Auction as Lot 28025. The auction house promoted the game as the earliest confirmed sealed edition of Super Mario Bros. and highlighted its condition alongside the circumstances of its discovery. The auction resulted in a $3 million sale. This had surpassed the previous $2 million record established by a private sale in 2021.The price of the copy is, therefore, tied to several aspects rather than just the age of the cartridge. Likely millions of people played the game, but this example belonged to a narrowly defined production variant, offering unparalleled historical provenance due to the un-boxing sequence. Additionally, its PSA 9.6 A++ grade further distinguished it from other surviving sealed copies of the same variant.
Article Summary: Super mario bros. was sealed inside an unopened nintendo entertainment system bundle. The copy was then discovered in 2026 and went to heritage auctions. It was sold for $3 million on 12 june 2026, setting a record for the highest price paid for a video game at a public auction.
